title: A Signal for the Protocol Revisited
author: Lior Thornbury
blurb: Wren Eastwick, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
